findings.location: Project settings section, project name input and Save button
findings.evidence: The project-settings form specifies a text input (value='Q3 Roadmap') and a Save button, but the artifact defines no next state or feedback message after submission
findings.violation: The save action changes stored state but the artifact specifies no visible indication of success or confirmation, leaving the user uncertain whether the action succeeded
findings.fix: Define a success state after save, such as a confirmation message ('Project name saved') or navigation to a confirmation screen that confirms the new name

findings.location: Notification settings section, digest frequency dropdown and Save button
findings.evidence: The notification-settings form specifies a select control with options (Daily, Weekly, Monthly) and a Save button, but the artifact defines no next state or feedback message after submission
findings.violation: The save action changes stored notification settings but the artifact specifies no visible indication of success or confirmation, leaving the user uncertain whether preferences were saved
findings.fix: Define a success state after save, such as a confirmation message ('Notification settings updated') or return to a screen confirming the change persisted

findings.location: Project settings section, Duplicate project button
findings.evidence: Button element with id='project-settings-duplicate-btn', type='button', aria-label='Duplicate project', but no visible text content, no icon, no title attribute, and no adjacent help text
findings.violation: The control requires explanation (what duplication creates and what state follows) but offers this explanation only in an aria-label attribute that is not visible on screen to sighted users
findings.fix: Add visible button text (e.g., 'Duplicate') or an icon with a title attribute, and specify what state or outcome follows the duplication action
